body.claim: The ledger is the only truth. This index, any cache and any projection must be reconstructible from it, and must never be the thing consulted when the two disagree.
body.detail: A derived store that can hold something the ledger cannot is a second source of truth, and the one that is easier to write to always wins. The index is deleted and rebuilt whenever its schema version moves or it fails to open, rather than migrated in place.

body.claim: Working on codedoc with its own MCP server connected locks codedoc-mcp.exe, so that one binary cannot be rebuilt until the editor session ends.
body.detail: .mcp.json runs the server through cargo run --release, which holds target/release/codedoc-mcp.exe open for the life of the session. A rebuild of that crate then fails with "Access is denied (os error 5)" on Windows. The gates are unaffected because they build the codedoc binary and the test targets rather than the server. A change to the server's instructions or tools therefore takes effect on the next session, not this one, which is also true of the instructions themselves since they are sent at initialize.
